welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: We invite all citizens to vote in referendums on current topics.

accordions.title: A unique, tamper-proof vote
accordions.content:
Voting is done by reading your ID card chip (not passport, to avoid double votes) locally on your phone to ensure:
1. You are French and of legal age
2. No one can vote twice

accordions.title: A guaranteed anonymous vote
accordions.content: It is impossible to know who voted what because records are encrypted locally on your phone before being sent to a public ledger where there is no link between your name and your vote.

accordions.title: A transparent vote
accordions.content: All votes visible on-chain are verifiable, allowing everyone to verify the presence of their vote and the legitimacy of others. The ledger is public and transparent. It cannot be altered once data is recorded.

accordions.title: Others can vote in your referendum
accordions.content: The app allows multiple people to vote on the same referendum. You can create your own referendum and invite others to participate.

accordions.title: What happens after counting votes?
accordions.content: There is no central computer collecting votes. Votes are recorded on thousands of computers. If the app is blocked or removed from app stores, it can be duplicated to continue voting.

origin.title: Where it comes from
origin.content:
Alexandre Jardin (writer, founder of #LesGueux) was convinced by his son Robinson Jardin (ex-NordVPN, now Nym) of blockchain’s potential for direct democracy.

They partnered with Alexis Roussel (Swiss digital democracy advocate, co-founder of Nym), who defined the application requirements.

Open-source app
Hosted by the Swiss Pirate Party
Local data processing - GDPR
